title: HB 229 (108th General Assembly): As enacted, specifies that only certain photo identification issued by state of Tennessee or United States may be used as evidence of identification for voting purposes; prohibits use of county or municipal identifications for voting purposes. - Amends TCA Title 2, Chapter 7, Part 1.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) TCA 2-7-112(c)(2), Section 1
(quote) A valid identification card issued by the state of Tennessee, or the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification; provided, that such identification card contains a photograph of the voter;
(section) TCA 2-7-112(c)(5), Section 2
(quote) A valid employee identification card issued by the state of Tennessee or the United States where authorized by law to issue employee identification; provided, that such identification card contains a photograph of the voter;
(section) TCA 2-7-112(g), new, Section 3
(quote) An identification card issued by a county or municipality or entity thereof, including a public library, containing a photograph shall not be evidence of identification for purposes of verifying the person's identification on the application for ballot.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec 4: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: Draft (only version saved; same text as SB125 Draft): limits accepted photo IDs to State of Tennessee or United States issuers and bars county, city and library IDs (slot a). The House committee amendment of 2013-03-19 and the House amendments HA0155 and HA0156 to SB125 are not saved; the enrolled text is not saved.
(other) note: Companion of SB125. House floor action was 'Comp. SB subst.' on 2013-03-25, so the House passed SB125 in its place; this bill's own record ends with 'Comp. became Pub. Ch. 178'. Text of the Public Chapter not saved.
